title: Se Lo --- The Pair That Does Not Exist

lessons.title: se lo — the pair that does not exist
lessons.gloss: the one pair Spanish will not say — le lo does not exist, and something else stands in for it

segments.text: Person first, then thing. So "I tell it to him" should be le plus lo plus digo. Say that out loud: le lo digo.
Your mouth probably objected before your grammar did. Le lo is two nearly identical syllables in a row, and Spanish will not say it.
In front of lo, la, los or las, the pronouns le and les become se.
Le lo digo. becomes Se lo digo. — I tell it to him. Les la hago. becomes Se la hago. — I make it for them.

Everything else about the sentence is unchanged. The order is still person then thing. The slot is still in front of the verb. Only the first word's shape changes, and it changes for one reason: what follows it.
Note what se does not tell you. Le already refused to mark gender, and se goes further — it does not mark number either:
Se lo digo — to him. To her. To you. To them. To you all.
Five readings, one word. Context does all the work, and if you need to be precise you add it in words rather than in the pronoun.

segments.prompt: Say I tell it to him.

feedback.correct: Se lo digo — le could not stand in front of lo.
feedback.incorrect: Se lo digo. Le becomes se before lo.

segments.prompt: In front of which four words do le and les become se?
acceptedResponses: the direct object pronouns for things

feedback.correct: Only those four, and always those four.

segments.prompt: How many different people can se lo digo be about?
acceptedResponses: five: him, her, you, them, you all
him her you them or you all

feedback.correct: Se marks neither gender nor number. Context carries it.
feedback.incorrect: Five — him, her, usted, them, ustedes. Se marks neither gender nor number.

segments.text: "I tell it to him"? (Se lo digo.) What happened to le? (It became se in front of lo.) Next: why it became se — and it is not the reason almost everyone assumes.
